populationServed.rationale: Railway Board leads a nationwide railway system with extensive passenger-facing infrastructure and 17 zonal railways.

grievanceRelevance.rationale: The ministry is fourth in the official Central grievance table, but the evidence does not attribute those receipts to Railway Board rather than a zone, division, production unit or separate body.

sourceCompleteness.rationale: Official structure and decentralized RTI evidence establish the Board's identity, but no current complete designation-based Railway Board CPIO/FAA and service-address mapping was verified.

filingAccessibility.rationale: A general Central filing route exists, but the exact portal label and whether the records belong to Railway Board, a zone, a division or another unit remain unresolved.

maintainability.rationale: Directory evidence is fragmented across Board, zone, division, department and unit pages and commonly includes changing incumbent details.

notes: Ministry-wide grievance volume cannot be assigned to Railway Board. Do not route passenger, ticketing, station, train, parcel, freight, recruitment, pension or project grievances to the Board without verified record custody. A nested authority model may be required. Never copy incumbent names or personal contact details from zonal directories into production data.
